A.name: Something online or doomscrolling
A.use: User selects Something online or Doomscrolling. Choose a concrete way to close the feed and do something away from it.
A.open: Close what you were looking at. Pick one thing to do next.

B.name: In bed and trying to sleep
B.use: User confirms they want sleep, including sleep after a shift. Quiet short actions take priority.
B.open: Choose something quiet you can do before trying to sleep again.

C.name: Just woke up and getting up
C.use: User selects Just woke up and wants to get up. Clock time alone does not select this bank.
C.open: Pick the first thing you want to do after getting up.

D.name: Bored or following the usual habit
D.use: User selects Bored or My usual routine and has no sleep goal taking priority.
D.open: Pick something you can start now.

E.name: Stressed or anxious
E.use: User selects Stressed or anxious. Match the action to their location and available time.
E.open: Choose one thing to do for the next few minutes.

F.name: Lonely or alone
F.use: User selects Lonely or Being alone. In-person company is optional; also offer an action they can do alone.
F.open: If someone is there, you can ask for a few minutes together.

G.name: Angry or upset after an argument
G.use: User selects Angry or An argument. Conversation-specific cards require an actual conversation or message thread.
G.open: Pick something you can do while you feel upset.

H.name: Putting off a task
H.use: User selects Putting something off. Use the first workable step of the actual task.
H.open: Choose the smallest part of the task you can start now.

I.name: Tired or hungry
I.use: User selects Tired or Hungry. Match food to hunger and rest to an appropriate break or sleep goal.
I.open: If you need food or rest, start there.

J.name: Turned on or thinking about porn
J.use: User selects Turned on, A thought I keep returning to, or I do not know. A sexual thought alone is not treated as a lapse.
J.open: You can start one of these while the urge is still there.

K.name: At work school or in a public place
K.use: User selects At work or school, A public space, or Out and about. Respect break time and the places they can use.
K.open: Choose something you can do here or during your break.

L.name: Low or restless
L.use: User selects Low or Restless. Give short practical actions without assuming a diagnosis.
L.open: Pick one thing that feels doable right now.

acts.title: Put the device down for three minutes
acts.steps: Close the content and lock the screen. Put the device face down on a surface just beyond easy reach. Leave it there for three minutes. You can remain seated.
acts.done: The content is closed and the device stayed down for three minutes.

acts.title: Shut the laptop and leave the chair
acts.steps: Close the content, shut the laptop lid, and move to a different chair or room for three minutes. Leave the laptop where it is.
acts.done: You spent three minutes away from the laptop.

acts.title: Walk indoors for five minutes
acts.steps: Close the content. Put the phone in your pocket or on a shelf and walk between two clear points indoors for five minutes at your usual pace.
acts.done: You walked for five minutes without reopening the content.

acts.title: Wash one mug
acts.steps: Close the content and leave the device outside the kitchen. Wash, rinse and dry one mug, then put it away.
acts.done: One mug is washed and put away.

acts.title: Read two pages
acts.steps: Close the content and put the device down. Open a physical book at your bookmark and read the next two pages.
acts.done: You read two pages with the content closed.

acts.title: Sit with someone at home
acts.steps: Close the content. Ask an awake person you trust, “Mind if I sit here for a few minutes?” Stay in the shared room for five minutes if they agree.
acts.done: You spent five minutes in their company.

acts.title: Stay seated and look around
acts.steps: Close what you were looking at and turn the screen face down. For one minute, look at three ordinary objects near you and notice their colours and shapes.
acts.done: You spent one minute looking at the room with the content closed.

acts.title: Fold three clean items
acts.steps: Close the feed and put the phone down. Fold three clean clothes or towels and put them together on a chair or shelf. Stop after three.
acts.done: Three clean items are folded.

acts.title: Put the phone inside your bag for three minutes
acts.steps: Close what you were looking at and lock the screen. Put the phone inside your bag, close the bag and leave it there for three minutes.
acts.done: The phone stayed in the closed bag for three minutes.

acts.title: Put three things ready by the door
acts.steps: Close the feed and put the phone down. Put your keys, bag and the item you need for your next planned outing beside the door. Use the three things you actually need, then stop.
acts.done: Three things are ready for your next planned outing.

acts.title: Move the phone away from the pillow
acts.steps: Put the phone on a stable surface across the room, or as far from the pillow as you can comfortably reach. Leave your usual alarm set. Settle back into bed without taking the phone with you.
acts.done: The phone is away from the pillow and you have returned to bed.

acts.title: Read two pages in dim light
acts.steps: Put the phone down. Read two pages of a familiar physical book in comfortable dim light, then put the book aside when you are ready to try sleeping.
acts.done: You read two pages without using a feed.

acts.title: Wash your face and return to bed
acts.steps: Leave the phone behind. Wash your face with ordinary comfortable-temperature water, dry it, and return to bed.
acts.done: You washed your face and returned without the phone.

acts.title: Take a few sips at the kitchen table
acts.steps: If you are thirsty, leave the phone in the bedroom, pour a small glass of water and sit at the table for two minutes. Return to bed when ready.
acts.done: You had water and two quiet minutes away from the screen.

acts.title: Straighten the pillow and cover
acts.steps: Put the phone down. Adjust the pillow and sheet or duvet until you are comfortable, then lie down for two minutes with the screen closed. You can do this from bed.
acts.done: You spent two minutes settled in bed with the screen closed.

acts.title: Fold three items quietly
acts.steps: If clean clothes are within reach, put the phone down and fold three items. Put them together on a chair or shelf, then return to bed.
acts.done: Three items are folded.

acts.title: Sit in a different chair briefly
acts.steps: Leave the phone down and move to a comfortable chair in another part of the room or home. Sit in low light for three minutes.
acts.done: You sat away from the screen for three minutes.

acts.title: Put out clothes for when you get up
acts.steps: Leave the phone down and put the clothes you plan to wear after sleeping on a chair. Stop after this one preparation and return to bed.
acts.done: Your clothes are ready for when you get up.

acts.title: Rest for one minute with the screen down
acts.steps: Put the phone face down. Notice where the mattress or chair supports you for one minute, breathing normally. If focusing on your body feels uncomfortable, look at one object in the room instead.
acts.done: You spent one minute with the screen down.

acts.title: Close your eyes for three minutes
acts.steps: Put the phone down, make yourself comfortable and close your eyes for three minutes. If a thought about watching comes up, notice it and stay where you are.
acts.done: You rested for three minutes without opening the content.

acts.title: Get dressed before opening anything else
acts.steps: Put the phone down and change out of your sleep clothes into the clothes you plan to wear today. Keep the screen closed until you are dressed.
acts.done: You are dressed for the day.

acts.title: Brush your teeth without the phone
acts.steps: Leave the phone where it is, go to the sink and brush your teeth for your usual two minutes. Continue with your usual routine after getting up.
acts.done: You brushed your teeth without the phone.

acts.title: Eat breakfast at the table
acts.steps: If you are hungry, make a breakfast you normally eat, such as toast or cereal. Sit at a table to eat it with the phone put down.
acts.done: You prepared and ate breakfast away from the feed.

acts.title: Make the bed
acts.steps: Leave the phone on a surface away from the bed. Straighten the sheet or duvet and put the pillows back. Leave the bedroom when you finish if you can.
acts.done: The bed is made.

acts.title: Pack three things for the day
acts.steps: Put your keys, wallet or travel card, and any item you need for work or study into your bag. Use your own equivalents; stop after the bag is ready.
acts.done: The bag is ready with the three things you need.

acts.title: Walk a short familiar route
acts.steps: Get dressed and take a familiar five-minute route from your front door and back at your usual pace. Keep the phone locked while moving.
acts.done: You completed the short route and returned.

acts.title: Buy one breakfast item
acts.steps: Walk to the nearest convenience store or supermarket you know is open and within a short familiar trip. Buy one item you actually want for breakfast, then come home. Choose a free option if you do not want to spend.
acts.done: You returned with one chosen item.

acts.title: Open the curtains and sit for a minute
acts.steps: If daylight is available and privacy allows, put the phone down, open the curtains and sit facing the room for one minute.
acts.done: The curtains are open and you spent a minute off the screen.

acts.title: Get the first work item ready
acts.steps: Put the phone down and place the one book, tool or document you need for your first planned task on the desk. Open it to the page or file you need.
acts.done: The first task is ready to start.

acts.title: Leave the bed for a seated activity
acts.steps: Move to a chair or your usual seated position. Put the phone down and spend three minutes looking at a physical book, magazine or printed page.
acts.done: You spent three minutes out of your sleeping position.

acts.title: Buy one useful item
acts.steps: Walk to the nearest convenience store or supermarket you know is open and reachable by a short familiar route. Buy one useful item, such as milk or a piece of fruit, and return. You choose the item and whether to spend.
acts.done: You returned with one chosen item.

acts.title: Walk for five minutes and come back
acts.steps: Set a five-minute timer, lock the screen and walk a short familiar route. Turn back after about two minutes so you finish near where you started. Look ahead while moving.
acts.done: You walked for five minutes and returned near the start.

acts.title: Clear one small surface
acts.steps: Put the phone down. Clear a bedside table, a desk corner or one section of the kitchen counter. Put away the items on that surface and stop there.
acts.done: One chosen surface is clear.

acts.title: Wash five dishes
acts.steps: Leave the phone outside the kitchen. Wash, rinse and place five dishes on the rack. Stop at five even if there are more.
acts.done: Five dishes are washed.

acts.title: Do one page of a paper puzzle
acts.steps: Put the phone down and work on one crossword, sudoku or puzzle page for five minutes. You do not have to finish it.
acts.done: You spent five minutes on the page.

acts.title: Read three pages
acts.steps: Open a physical book at the next unread page. Read three pages with the phone face down, then decide whether to carry on.
acts.done: You read three pages.

acts.title: Fold five clothes
acts.steps: Put the phone down and fold five clean items. Stack them or put them in the drawer, then stop.
acts.done: Five items are folded and placed together.

acts.title: Water one houseplant
acts.steps: If one of your houseplants needs water, put the phone down, fill your usual small watering container and water that plant as you normally would. Put the container away when you finish.
acts.done: One plant that needed water has been watered.

acts.title: Make one small snack
acts.steps: If you are hungry, prepare one snack you normally eat, such as a sandwich or fruit. Sit at a table to eat with the phone put down.
acts.done: You made and ate one snack away from the feed.

acts.title: Draw one object near you
acts.steps: Put the phone down and spend three minutes sketching a mug, shoe or other object on paper. Copy its outline and a few details.
acts.done: You spent three minutes drawing the object.

acts.title: Rinse one mug and fill it with water
acts.steps: Put the phone down, rinse one mug and fill it with drinking water. Sit with it for two minutes and take a few sips if you want them.
acts.done: The mug is ready and you sat for two minutes.

acts.title: Walk indoors for three minutes
acts.steps: Put the phone down and walk between two clear points indoors at a comfortable pace for three minutes.
acts.done: You walked for three minutes.

acts.title: Look at one ordinary object
acts.steps: Turn the screen face down. Spend one minute looking at a mug, door handle or other object. Notice its edges, material and colour. Breathe normally.
acts.done: You spent one minute looking at the object.

acts.title: Wash your face
acts.steps: Leave the phone down. Wash your face with comfortable-temperature water and pat it dry. Return to a chair with the phone still down for one minute.
acts.done: You washed your face and sat for a minute.

acts.title: Sit beside someone for five minutes
acts.steps: If someone you trust is there and awake, ask, “Can I sit with you for a few minutes?” If they agree, sit nearby for five minutes with the phone down. You can talk about something ordinary or stay quiet.
acts.done: You spent five minutes beside someone who agreed to have company.

acts.title: Spend five minutes outside on a known route
acts.steps: If going out is suitable, take a familiar five-minute route and return. Keep your pace comfortable and your screen locked.
acts.done: You completed the short route.

acts.title: Sort five loose items
acts.steps: Put the phone down. Choose five items on your desk or table and put each in its usual place. Stop after those five.
acts.done: Five items are in their usual places.

acts.title: Fold three towels or clothes
acts.steps: Put the phone down. Fold three clean towels or clothes at your usual pace and put them in one place. Leave the rest of the pile for later.
acts.done: Three items are folded and put together.

acts.title: Notice the worry and sit for two minutes
acts.steps: Put the screen down. Say once, “I'm having the thought that...” and finish with the worry already on your mind. Sit for two minutes with your eyes open. You do not need to solve it right now.
acts.done: You noticed the thought and spent two minutes off the screen.

acts.title: Open the first task and do one small part
acts.steps: If a specific task is worrying you, put the phone down and work on its first small part for two minutes: read the question, open the bill, or place the needed tool on the table.
acts.done: You spent two minutes on the chosen first part.

acts.title: Start a short conversation with someone there
acts.steps: If a person you know is there and willing to talk, put the phone down and ask one ordinary question, such as “How was your day?” Spend up to five minutes talking. You do not need to explain the urge.
acts.done: You asked one question and stayed for the conversation if they wanted to talk.

acts.title: Sit with an awake person at home
acts.steps: Ask a trusted person, “Mind if I sit with you for a bit?” If they agree, sit in the shared room for five minutes with your phone down.
acts.done: You spent five minutes in agreed company.

acts.title: Take a five-minute walk with someone there
acts.steps: Ask someone you know who is already there, “Want to walk around the block with me?” If they agree and the route is suitable, take a familiar five-minute route together and return. Keep the phone locked.
acts.done: You completed the short walk together and returned.

acts.title: Read for five minutes at the nearby library
acts.steps: Walk to a library you know is open and no more than five minutes away. Spend five minutes reading one physical book or magazine, then walk back. Choose this only when the full trip fits fifteen minutes.
acts.done: You read for five minutes at the library and returned.

acts.title: Make a brief errand to a familiar shop
acts.steps: Go to a nearby open convenience store or supermarket by a short familiar route. Buy one useful item if you want to spend, use the normal checkout and return. You do not have to make small talk.
acts.done: You completed the errand and returned.

acts.title: Wash and dry three cups together
acts.steps: If someone at home wants to join you, ask them to dry while you wash three cups, or swap jobs. Put the phone down, finish those three cups and stop.
acts.done: Three cups have been washed and dried together.

acts.title: Sit on a familiar public bench for five minutes
acts.steps: Walk to a nearby bench or public seating area you already know, where other people are usually around. Sit for five minutes with the phone in your pocket, then return. Choose a familiar route and a suitable time.
acts.done: You spent five minutes in the public seating area and returned.

acts.title: Deal a hand of solitaire with real cards
acts.steps: Put the phone down and lay out a game of solitaire with a physical pack of cards. Play for five minutes at a table or on a tray. You do not need to finish the game.
acts.done: You spent five minutes playing with the cards.

acts.title: Read in an appropriate shared place
acts.steps: If there is a safe common room or shared seating area available, take a physical book there and read three pages. You do not need to talk to anyone.
acts.done: You read three pages in the shared space.

acts.title: Read two pages in another room
acts.steps: If you are alone and cannot get company right now, take a physical book to a comfortable chair in another room. Put the phone down and read two pages.
acts.done: You read two pages in the other room.

acts.title: Leave the message thread closed
acts.steps: Close the message or social app connected to what upset you, lock the screen and put it face down for five minutes. Do not use the five minutes to draft a reply.
acts.done: The thread stayed closed for five minutes.

acts.title: Walk indoors for five minutes
acts.steps: Put the phone down and walk between two clear points indoors at a comfortable pace for five minutes. Keep the screen closed while you walk.
acts.done: You walked for five minutes with the screen closed.

acts.title: Wash three dishes
acts.steps: Leave the phone outside the kitchen. Wash, rinse and place three dishes on the rack. Stop after those three.
acts.done: Three dishes are washed.

acts.title: Wash your hands and sit down
acts.steps: Put the phone down, wash and dry your hands normally, then sit in a different chair for two minutes if one is available.
acts.done: You washed your hands and sat for two minutes.

acts.title: Take a short walk without replying
acts.steps: If going out is suitable, walk a familiar five-minute route and return. Keep the phone locked and leave any reply until after the walk.
acts.done: You completed the route with the conversation closed.

acts.title: Ask someone there to talk about something else
acts.steps: If a person you trust is there and willing to talk, say, “I’m upset. Can we talk about something else for a few minutes?” Put the phone down and talk for up to five minutes. If an argument upset you, choose someone who was not involved.
acts.done: You spent a few minutes in an agreed conversation about something else.

acts.title: Put five things back in place
acts.steps: Put the phone down and return five ordinary items on a table or desk to their usual places. Stop after those five.
acts.done: Five items are put away.

acts.title: Read two pages of a familiar book
acts.steps: Put the phone down and read two pages of a physical book you already know. If your attention wanders, return to the next sentence.
acts.done: You read two physical pages.

acts.title: Fold three towels
acts.steps: Put the phone down and fold three clean towels. Put them on a shelf or together on a chair. Stop after those three.
acts.done: Three towels are folded.

acts.title: Name what happened and pause
acts.steps: With the phone face down, say one plain sentence to yourself: “I'm upset about...” Use only what actually happened. Spend the next two minutes looking at the room.
acts.done: You named the event and paused for two minutes.

acts.title: Open the document and work for two minutes
acts.steps: Put the phone down. Open the actual document you have been avoiding and work on its first unfinished part for two minutes. You can stop when the timer ends.
acts.done: You spent two minutes on the document.

acts.title: Read the first question
acts.steps: Put the phone down. Open the assignment and read the first unanswered question once. Mark the part you need to work on, or place your finger beside it.
acts.done: You identified the first question to attempt.

acts.title: Wash the first three dishes
acts.steps: If the avoided task is washing up, leave the phone down and wash three dishes. Stop there if you want.
acts.done: The first three dishes are washed.

acts.title: Put the first five items away
acts.steps: If the avoided task is tidying, put the phone down and return the first five visible misplaced items to their places. Stop after five.
acts.done: Five items are put away.

acts.title: Open the bill or letter
acts.steps: If you have been avoiding a bill or letter, put the phone down and open it. Read what it says and check for a due date or requested next step. You do not have to pay or solve it in this session.
acts.done: You opened it and checked what it asks you to do.

acts.title: Set out one tool or material
acts.steps: Put the phone down and place the first tool, textbook or material needed for the job where you will use it. Spend the next minute looking at the first step.
acts.done: The first item is ready where you need it.

acts.title: Make a two-minute start on the email
acts.steps: If an email is the task, open only that draft. Write the subject and first sentence, then save it. You can decide later whether to finish and send.
acts.done: A draft has a subject and first sentence.

acts.title: Work beside someone for five minutes
acts.steps: If a trusted person is present and willing, ask to sit nearby while you spend five minutes on the actual task. They do not need to supervise you.
acts.done: You spent five minutes on the task with agreed company.

acts.title: Put one load into the washing machine
acts.steps: If laundry is the task and it is an appropriate time for noise, put one ordinary load into the machine and start your usual cycle. Leave the rest of the laundry for later.
acts.done: One normal load has started.

acts.title: Read one page needed for the task
acts.steps: Put the phone down and read the first relevant page of the textbook, manual or printed instructions. Stop after one page.
acts.done: You read one relevant page.

acts.title: Eat one ready-to-eat snack
acts.steps: If you are hungry, choose a food you normally eat that needs little preparation, such as fruit, yoghurt or a sandwich. Put the phone down and sit to eat it.
acts.done: You ate one suitable snack without browsing.

acts.title: Make one sandwich and eat it at the table
acts.steps: If you are hungry and have the ingredients, put two slices of bread on a plate and add a filling you normally eat. Put the phone down and sit at a table to eat the sandwich.
acts.done: You made and ate one sandwich with the phone down.

acts.title: Pour water and sit for three minutes
acts.steps: If you are thirsty, fill a glass with drinking water. Put the phone down and sit for three minutes, taking a few sips if you want.
acts.done: You had three seated minutes and water available.

acts.title: Rest in a chair for five minutes
acts.steps: If you are tired and can safely take a break, put the phone face down and rest in a comfortable chair for five minutes. Keep your eyes open if that suits you better.
acts.done: You rested for five minutes without browsing.

acts.title: Change into your sleep clothes
acts.steps: If you want to sleep and have not changed yet, put the phone down and change into your usual sleep clothes. Put your daytime clothes in their normal place and settle into bed.
acts.done: You changed into your sleep clothes with the screen closed.

acts.title: Put out clothes for when you next get up
acts.steps: Put the phone down and put the clothes you plan to wear after sleeping on a chair or shelf. Stop once that one outfit is ready.
acts.done: One outfit is ready for when you get up.

acts.title: Ask for a short break
acts.steps: If work or caring duties are covered, ask the relevant person for a five-minute break, or take an already permitted break. Spend it seated with the phone put down.
acts.done: You took a permitted break; essential duties remained covered.

acts.title: Eat in the staffroom or kitchen
acts.steps: If you are hungry and have brought food, take it to a suitable staffroom or kitchen table and eat for five minutes with the phone away.
acts.done: You spent five minutes eating in the chosen place.

acts.title: Put out a bowl and spoon for breakfast
acts.steps: If you normally eat breakfast at home, put a bowl and spoon on the kitchen counter for when you next get up. Leave the phone behind and stop after those two items are ready.
acts.done: The bowl and spoon are ready for your next breakfast.

acts.title: Rest for two minutes with the screen down
acts.steps: Put the phone face down, sit in a comfortable supported position and rest for two minutes. You can keep your eyes open. Use this when you have a break or no task needing your attention.
acts.done: You rested for two minutes with the screen down.

acts.title: Put the phone down for three minutes
acts.steps: Close any feed or page you were browsing and lock the screen. Put the phone face down beside you for three minutes. You can remain seated.
acts.done: The screen stayed closed for three minutes.

acts.title: Look around for one minute
acts.steps: Put the phone face down. Find three ordinary objects you can see and look at their shapes and colours for one minute.
acts.done: You spent one minute looking at the room.

acts.title: Read two physical pages
acts.steps: Put the phone down and open a physical book. Read the next two pages, returning to the sentence when your attention wanders.
acts.done: You read two pages with the feed closed.

acts.title: Walk indoors for five minutes
acts.steps: Put the phone down and walk between two clear points indoors at your usual pace for five minutes.
acts.done: You walked for five minutes without reopening the cue.

acts.title: Wash one mug
acts.steps: Leave the phone down. Wash, rinse and dry one mug, then put it away.
acts.done: One mug is washed and put away.

acts.title: Fold three clothes
acts.steps: Put the phone down and fold three clean items. Put them together on a chair, shelf or in a drawer.
acts.done: Three items are folded.

acts.title: Return to your task for two minutes
acts.steps: Return to the ordinary activity you meant to do before the urge: read one page, prepare the next ingredient, or work on the first unfinished part for two minutes. Use the activity you actually planned.
acts.done: You spent two minutes on the intended activity.

acts.title: Draw the outline of one object
acts.steps: Put the phone down. On paper, draw the outline of one object near you, such as a mug, shoe or lamp. Spend three minutes on that one drawing; it does not have to look good.
acts.done: You spent three minutes drawing one object.

acts.title: Sit in a different safe spot
acts.steps: If moving is suitable, leave the device down and move to another chair or room for three minutes. Choose a place you feel comfortable being.
acts.done: You spent three minutes in the different spot.

acts.title: Take a familiar five-minute walk
acts.steps: If you can safely go out, follow a short familiar route and return after five minutes. Keep the screen locked while moving.
acts.done: You completed the short route.

acts.title: Put the phone away for two minutes
acts.steps: Close the feed and lock the screen. Put the phone in a bag, pocket or face down on a desk for two minutes. Keep essential work or accessibility functions available.
acts.done: The feed stayed closed for two minutes.

acts.title: Return from the bathroom
acts.steps: If you are lingering in a bathroom with the phone, lock it, finish what you came in to do, wash your hands and return to the appropriate shared area.
acts.done: You left the bathroom and returned to the shared area.

acts.title: Refill your water bottle
acts.steps: During a permitted break, lock the phone, go to the nearest drinking-water point, refill your bottle and return to your seat or workstation.
acts.done: The bottle is refilled and you are back.

acts.title: Read one printed page
acts.steps: Put the phone down and read one page of a physical book, handout or printed document you have with you. Continue from where you last stopped.
acts.done: You read one page off the phone.

acts.title: Start two minutes of the next work task
acts.steps: Close the feed and spend two minutes on the next required work or study step. Open only the file or material needed for it.
acts.done: You worked on the required step for two minutes.

acts.title: Look at three things near you
acts.steps: Put the phone down. Stay seated and spend one minute looking at three ordinary objects nearby. Notice one colour or shape on each.
acts.done: You spent one minute looking away from the screen.

acts.title: Sort five things in your bag
acts.steps: Put the phone away and straighten five ordinary items in your bag, such as your keys, travel card, pen, book and headphones. Keep your belongings with you.
acts.done: Five items are in order.

acts.title: Take one permitted corridor break
acts.steps: If leaving the desk is allowed, lock the phone and walk to a known safe point in the corridor and back for three minutes. Keep access to your work and care duties.
acts.done: You completed the permitted short break.

acts.title: Pack away one item you have finished using
acts.steps: Put the phone away. Close the book or notebook you have finished with, put it back in your bag and leave the bag beside you. Stop after that one item.
acts.done: One finished item is back in your bag.

acts.title: Ask a colleague about one ordinary thing
acts.steps: During an appropriate break, ask a willing colleague or classmate one normal question about the shared task or break plans. Keep the conversation brief; you do not need to disclose the urge.
acts.done: You made one appropriate attempt at conversation; their response is not required.

acts.title: Put the phone down for two minutes
acts.steps: Lock the screen and put the phone face down beside you. Leave it there for two minutes. You can stay seated.
acts.done: The phone stayed down for two minutes.

acts.title: Sit in a different chair for three minutes
acts.steps: Leave the phone down and move to another comfortable chair or room. Sit there for three minutes, with your eyes open.
acts.done: You spent three minutes in the other chair.

acts.title: Read two pages of a familiar book
acts.steps: Put the phone down and open a physical book you already know. Read two pages at your usual pace. If your attention wanders, return to the next sentence.
acts.done: You read two pages with the phone down.

acts.title: Wash one plate
acts.steps: Leave the phone outside the kitchen. Wash and rinse one plate, then put it on the rack or dry it and put it away. Stop after that plate.
acts.done: One plate is washed.

acts.title: Fold three clean items
acts.steps: Put the phone down and fold three clean clothes or towels. Put them together on a chair, shelf or in a drawer. Leave the rest for later.
acts.done: Three clean items are folded.

acts.title: Walk indoors for three minutes
acts.steps: Put the phone down and walk between two clear points indoors at a comfortable pace for three minutes. Finish near the place where you started.
acts.done: You walked indoors for three minutes with the screen closed.

acts.title: Eat the snack you already have
acts.steps: If you are hungry, get one food you normally eat that needs little preparation, such as fruit, yoghurt or a sandwich. Put the phone down and sit to eat it.
acts.done: You ate a suitable snack with the phone down.

acts.title: Sort five things in your bag
acts.steps: Put the phone down. Pick five ordinary items already in your bag and put each where you normally keep it. Close the bag when you finish.
acts.done: Five items are in their usual places in your bag.

acts.title: Walk to a familiar corner and back
acts.steps: If going out is suitable, walk to a corner or landmark you know is about two minutes away, then return the same way. Set a five-minute timer before you leave and keep the phone locked.
acts.done: You walked to the familiar point and returned.

acts.title: Name the feeling and pause for one minute
acts.steps: Put the phone down. Say once to yourself, “I feel low” or “I feel restless”, using whichever fits. Spend one minute looking at one object in the room.
acts.done: You named the feeling and spent one minute with the screen down.
